svg.title: Architecture in six steps. 1 Collect: Play Store, App Store, Reddit and YouTube, every platform in parallel, and each app match is verified by title or the source collects nothing. 2 Prepare: exact duplicate removal on normalised text, every removal counted. 3 Label: the deductive frame is applied by published rules to 100% of the corpus, with no model. 4 Sample: a deterministic stratified draw by source, platform and rating band for the model layer. 5 Induce: the model (Groq) discovers themes from that sample and classifies the same sample. 6 Score: the opportunity formula. Five of the six steps need no LLM: if Groq is unavailable, step 5 is skipped and the run still produces a complete analysis with 100% coverage. The model is an enhancement, not a dependency.

section.data-alt: Architecture in six steps. 1 Collect: Play Store, App Store, Reddit and YouTube, every platform in parallel, and each app match is verified by title or the source collects nothing. 2 Prepare: exact duplicate removal on normalised text, every removal counted. 3 Label: the deductive frame is applied by published rules to 100% of the corpus, with no model. 4 Sample: a deterministic stratified draw by source, platform and rating band for the model layer. 5 Induce: the model (Groq) discovers themes from that sample and classifies the same sample. 6 Score: the opportunity formula. Five of the six steps need no LLM: if Groq is unavailable, step 5 is skipped and the run still produces a complete analysis with 100% coverage. The model is an enhancement, not a dependency.

div.p: Each step publishes its rule. Only one of the six touches a language model, so a run never depends on one.
All four sources, every platform in parallel. An app match is verified by title, or the source collects nothing.
Exact duplicates removed on normalised text. Every removal counted.
Deductive frame applied by published rules to 100% of the corpus.
Deterministic stratified draw: source × platform × rating band.
Groq proposes themes from the sample and classifies that same sample.
Transparent opportunity formula, every component a column.
steps run without a model. If Groq is unavailable, step 5 is skipped and the run still returns a complete analysis with 100% coverage. The model is an enhancement, not a dependency.
